paths.en: Create a Course or Knowledge Product with AI
paths.zh: 用 AI 做课程或知识产品
paths.enDescription: Use AI to design learning objectives, curriculum, media and publishable knowledge assets.
paths.zhDescription: 利用 AI 设计学习目标、课程结构、多媒体和可发布的知识资产。
paths.enGoal: Turn source material into a coherent learning product rather than a pile of generated lessons.
paths.zhGoal: 把素材变成连贯的学习产品，而不是一堆生成课文。
paths.enDeliverable: A structured course or knowledge product with reviewable learning objectives.
paths.zhDeliverable: 一套具有可审查学习目标的课程或知识产品。

milestones.zh: 设计学习目标与课程结构

paths.en: Run a Solo Business with AI
paths.zh: 用 AI 经营一人公司
paths.enDescription: Use AI across customer research, content, automation and support without losing operational control.
paths.zhDescription: 把 AI 用于客户研究、内容、自动化与客服，同时保持运营控制。
paths.enGoal: Build repeatable workflows and keep humans at consequential boundaries.
paths.zhGoal: 建立可重复工作流，并在高后果边界保留人工判断。
paths.enDeliverable: An AI-assisted operating system for a small one-person business.
paths.zhDeliverable: 一套面向一人公司的 AI 辅助运营系统。

paths.enDescription: Progress from support copilot to bounded support automation with knowledge and escalation.
paths.zhDescription: 从 Support Copilot 逐步走向带知识库与 Escalation 的有边界自动化。
paths.enGoal: Combine knowledge retrieval, tools, runtime state and human escalation.
paths.zhGoal: 结合 Knowledge Retrieval、Tools、Runtime State 与 Human Escalation。
paths.enDeliverable: A support system architecture with clear source, tool and escalation boundaries.
paths.zhDeliverable: 一套具有明确 Source、Tool 与 Escalation 边界的客服系统架构。

milestones.zh: 让客服基于持续维护的知识
限制自动化并设计 Escalation
